notes.title: Release Notes - December 22, 2022
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that you can now earn Steam Trading Cards for some of our beloved Misfits and listen to the full Flippin Misfits soundtrack!

Changes:
[list]
[*] Two new maps: Lookout and Nova Beach Club
[*] Added Steam Trading Cards and Badges
[*] The Flippin Misfits soundtrack, composed by Fred Falke, is available [url=https://songwhip.com/fred-falke/flippin-misfits-original-game-soundtrack]here[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes - November 17th 2022
notes.content:
Hello Misfits,
We’ve collected your feedback and are now pushing an update that should alleviate some of the pain points encountered during the free weekend.
Thanks for your support!

Balance Changes
•	Tweaked movement speed and terminal velocity
•	Tweaked camera to alleviate issues in tight corners
•	“Kick” feature has been disabled
•	Removed “Butcher” and “Born To Fly” mods

notes.title: Play Flippin Misfits and Claim your Exclusive Dead by Daylight Charm
notes.content:
DECEMBER 19 UPDATE: The special collaboration has ended and the Dead by Daylight Voxel Trapper Charm is no longer available.

As a special collaboration, players who purchase [i]Flippin Misfits[/i] will receive an exclusive Dead by Daylight Trapper charm, redeemable in [i]Dead by Daylight[/i].  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749778/525bac0a080636202dad860c39afec9020dcbbd1.jpg[/img]

Here’s how to claim your new Charm: 
[list]
[*] If you don't have it, purchase or redeem a Steam key to add Flippin Misfits to your Steam library 
[list][*] The Free Weekend version is not eligible to redeem the Charm
[*] Only those who have made a purchase or redeemed a Steam key are eligible to receive the Charm[/list]
[*] Link your Behaviour account to your Steam account 
[list][*] If you don’t have one, you can create an account here [url=https://account.bhvr.com]https://account.bhvr.com[/url][/list]
[*] Go to the Dead by Daylight Account page and click ‘Claim Now’ underneath the picture of the Voxel Trapper Charm 
[list][*] Copy the code to the clipboard so you don’t forget it![/list]
[*] Launch Dead by Daylight on any platform 
[*] Go to the Store and select ‘Redeem Code’ 
[*] Input your code and enjoy your Voxel Trapper Charm 
[list][*] The Charm will be located in your Inventory [/list]
[/list]
Grab your friends and play for free between now and November 14th. Join the Flippin party! 

Irreverently yours, 

The Flippin Misfits team
